_doc: Declared absent lesson ids. R2 of scripts/verify_ledger_singleton.py fails the build on any absent id that is NOT declared here. An id is declared absent with a reason, or the gate refuses. D-007 generalised: a gap is a finding with a cause, never a hole nobody named.
_authority: ops/LESSONS_LEDGER.md is the single canonical store, mirrored byte-identical across qesis-mcp and sovereign-infra. CLAUDE.md section 0 and section 5 step 4.

declared_absent.closes_when: each id is written as an entry, then removed from this list
